briefs.text: Oil: Brent falls to $90.97 as glut fears offset war risk.
Dollar steadies before US inflation data; bitcoin $59,258.
US pauses joint military operations with Ecuador.
Sarkozy and wife ordered to trial in corruption case.
Fort Hood gunman seeks stay of execution.
Australia signs security pact with Solomon Islands.
Houthi drone hits Riyadh's tallest tower; 11 wounded.
Gaza: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief, six others.
Yemen: Saudi strikes kill 17 telecom staff, 26 travellers.
Hasina plans return to Bangladesh on 16 December.
Malaysia to send 6,500 Rohingya back to Myanmar.
Nepal: magnitude 5.6 quake strikes Koshi province.
UAE: bus-truck crash death toll rises to 13.
AIDS deaths fall to 570,000, lowest in over 20 years.
Russian jets enter South Korea's air defence zone.
Trump pardons turkeys Freedom and Feathers.
Citi weighs return to Venezuela after five-year exit.
Broncos suspend running back Dobbins for conduct.
EU-Western Balkans summit opens in Brussels.
World marks day against violence against women.
DRC: aircraft missing as rebels claim they shot it down.
Abrego Garcia to leave US for Spain in deportation deal.
Democrats' House majority reaches at least 259 seats.
